description: This Go source file provides a wrapper around the sqlx database library, enabling enhanced database operations with features like timeout handling, tracing, and online status monitoring. It defines wrapper classes for database and transaction operations, supporting both direct queries and builder-based SQL generation, specifically tailored for the Mattermost application's SQL store layer.

classes.name: sqlxDBWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around sqlx.DB adding timeout, tracing, and online status features.

classes.name: sqlxTxWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around sqlx.Tx providing similar features for transactions.
